headline: Equities attempt a relief bounce as crude pulls back from six-month highs, but the tape carries two weekend overhangs — a Middle East supply scare and an unexpected Lula re-election rattling EM sentiment — heading into the heaviest macro week of the quarter.
Tech and oil pulled markets in opposite directions as AI spending anxiety from Meta and Tesla earnings collided with a surging crude-price shock tied to Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia

Tech imploded on Meta's $145B AI bill and Saudi oil strikes; small-caps and the Dow barely flinched — the real verdict arrives Wednesday when the Fed, Microsoft, and Alphabet all report within hours of each other.
SpaceX and SMCI ignited an AI rebound mid-session, but Thursday's real story writes itself tonight when Meta and Tesla report after the bell
Relief rally on unconfirmed Iran diplomacy lifts all indices — but Netflix, Meta, and Tesla earnings over the next 36 hours are the real verdict on where this market goes next.
